title: Consolidated Water Sets Investor Conference Call to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. ET
summary: GEORGE TOWN, Cayman Islands, July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Consolidated Water Co. Ltd . (NASDAQ Global Select Market: CWCO), a leading designer, builder and operator of advanced water treatment plants, will hold a conference call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern time to discuss its results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. The financial results will be issued in a press release prior to the call. Consolidated Water management will host the call, followed by a question-and-answer period. Date: Tuesday, August 11, 2026 Time: 11:00 a.m. Eastern time (8:00 a.m. Pacific time) Toll-free dial-in number: 1-844-875-6913 International dial-in number: 1-412-317-6709 Participant web phone: click here Conference ID: 4016150 Please call the conference telephone number five minutes prior to the start time.
